claim_boundary: This record carries only what stock Emacs project.el and stock Eglot recognized and selected per fixture case.
It does not prove module/configuration semantics and introduces no semantic root support cell; no custom project backend, lsp-mode result, or server-root heuristic may appear.
Promotion of any observed fact into editor_client_compat.v1 happens only through #11360/#11361 producer lanes; this intermediate artifact is never durable compat evidence by itself.
Subject classes are citable against xtask::emacs_subject_fan_in::SUBJECT_DENOMINATOR (#8755/#12726); this file binds no digest bytes itself.

subjects_deferred.reason: upstream-source subject materializes but keeps its typed launch refusal until its journey adapter lane lands

recording_rules: Each target file opens without prebinding the expected root: no env/config/fixture authority injects a root into stock selection.
project-remember-project and known roots are never pre-populated for any row.
The process working directory is never equated to or used as project root authority.
An outer Git root disposition is recorded independently; it may not be inferred from fixture expectation metadata.
Sibling, worktree, and standalone dispositions are each observed separately and are never inferred from one another.
Missing instrumentation records unsupported-by-instrument refusal, never a pass.
Stale client/process/session observation must never satisfy a row; generation identity accompanies every observation.
Negative answers serialize through native false/null sentinels so absent recognition stays a recorded fact.

instrument.binding: PERL_LSP_EGLOT_ROOT_PROBE_FILE/RECEIPT/CASE bind the exact opened file, receipt path, and row id; PERL_LSP_EGLOT_ROOT_PROBE_FIXTURE_ROOT anchors every durable relative path; PERL_LSP_EGLOT_ROOT_PROBE_SUBJECT and PERL_LSP_EGLOT_ROOT_PROBE_GENERATION bind the exact subject and server generation carried into the receipt; PERL_LSP_EGLOT_ROOT_PROBE_CANDIDATE supplies the exact candidate when a session can exist

limitations: Hosted-run observation was unavailable for this cut: no exact pinned Emacs build (29.4/30.1 GNU ELPA-resolved subjects) exists on the authoring host and no hosted runner executes Emacs today, so all twelve rows stay explicitly hosted_pending with unobserved slots instead of manufactured passes.
The instrument records only after cleanup verification; no row may claim facts from a torn-down-but-alive process generation.
Fixture-relative identities only: durable rows never carry absolute host paths.

observation_denominator.definition: The durable denominator is every case x in-scope-subject cell; a hosted run fills at most one observation per subject per case and may never overwrite another subject's cell.

observation_slots.definition: Each observation object carries exactly these slots — no more and no fewer — bound to the run that produced them; the driver's receipt key set is checked against this vocabulary.
